summary: Iteration 9 (ZenTaap rebrand + Razorpay scaffold + QR codes + customer cart UX) tested end-to-end. Backend 7/7 PASS via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9.py: GET /api/payments/config returns configured=false + fallback_link containing 'razorpay.me/@prem9300'; GET /api/subscription returns cycle_end (= next_cycle_start - 1 day, verified: 2026-07-09 == 2026-07-10 - 1d), autopay_enabled (bool), razorpay_customer_id (null), last_payment_id (null/string); POST /api/payments/create-order {tables:14} with no keys returns {configured:false, fallback_link, amount:<paise>, currency:'INR'}; POST /api/payments/verify with order/payment ids and no signature marks subscription_status='active', sets last_payment_id, last_payment_at, autopay_enabled=true (verified via GET /api/subscription); PUT /api/subscription/autopay {enabled:false} flips autopay_enabled off and on; POST /api/payments/webhook event='payment.captured' returns {received:true, event:'payment.captured'} and sets subscription active+autopay+last_payment_id; POST /api/orders {table:0, items:[...]} succeeds (walk-in flow). Frontend (Playwright): Login page DOC TITLE='ZenTaap — Scan. Order. Enjoy.', logo src='/logo.png', body contains 'ZenTaap'+'New to ZenTaap?', no 'TableTaap/TableTap' string, Razorpay script tag present in <head>. Customer page (?table=7): customer-table-badge text='Table 7' with .table-badge class + lock SVG icon; cart drawer header has data-testid='cart-table-pill' text='Table 7' and there is NO 'Your Cart' text and NO cart-table-input element; clicking cart-place-order-btn shows order-success-overlay with 'Order Placed!' + 'Sit tight at Table 7 — kitchen is on it.' + 'Order ID · #1036' and .confetti element present. Subscribe page: qr-preview-card rendered, qr-grid contains 12 .qr-tile + 1 .qr-tile-more (=13 elements; tables=20, '+8 more' label); first tile data-testid='qr-tile-1' SVG QR encodes value='https://zentaapqr.com/customer?table=1' (verified by React fiber introspection); autopay-card present, autopay-state='ON' with class='autopay-state on' (because /payments/verify was executed during backend tests, flipping it true); cycle-pill-end label='Ends on 9 Jul 2026' (not 'Renews on'); cycle-pill-start='Started 10 Jun 2026'. Manager → Tables: tables-section present, count=20 (matches subscription.tables); toggle-qr-btn + print-qr-btn present; clicking toggle reveals tables-qr-grid with 20 .table-qr-card elements, download-qr-1 through download-qr-20 exist; clicking download-qr-1 creates a Blob of type 'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8' size=3304 bytes (verified by intercepting URL.createObjectURL).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1110 lines — should be split into routers/{payments,subscription,auth,...}.py to keep modules under 700 lines. Carry-over from prior iterations.

/api/payments/webhook accepts events without signature verification when RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET is unset — necessary for demo mode but should explicitly log/warn so this state isn't accidentally shipped to prod (consider returning 503 if not configured in a 'strict' env flag).
/api/subscription/autopay PUT takes an untyped dict; should be a Pydantic body model (AutopayBody{enabled:bool}) for stronger validation, currently accepts anything truthy.

Customer.jsx is ~490 lines — still mixes PIN gate, menu list, cart drawer, and the new OrderSuccessOverlay; suggest splitting OrderSuccessOverlay into its own component file (it's already a small functional component, just hoist).

Subscribe.jsx is ~527 lines and packs price calculator, QR preview grid, autopay card, cycle banner, payment method picker, Razorpay launcher into one screen — split into Subscribe/{PriceCalculator,QrPreview,AutopayCard,CycleBanner,PayMethods}.jsx.

Customer PIN was found to be '1111' at the start of testing (drift from a previous iteration's settings test); auto-restored to '1234' before frontend test run. Recommend adding a setUp/tearDown step in test_settings to always restore customer_pin to default '1234' regardless of pass/fail.
test_credentials: Manager PIN 1234 (unchanged). Customer PIN was 1111 before testing (drift), restored to 1234.
seed_data_creation: Backend test_payments_verify_marks_active_and_enables_autopay set last_payment_id='pay_TEST_iter9' / order_id='order_TEST_iter9'; test_webhook_payment_captured_no_signature overwrote it with last_payment_id='pay_TEST_webhook_iter9'. Subscription status now 'active' with autopay_enabled=true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-9 features verified working. Key testids confirmed working: customer-table-badge (.table-badge with lock svg), cart-table-pill, no cart-table-input, order-success-overlay (.confetti, auto-dismiss 3.2s), qr-preview-card, qr-grid, qr-tile-1..12, qr-tile-more (+N more), autopay-card, autopay-state (.on/.off), sub-cycle-dates with .cycle-pill-start/.cycle-pill-end ('Started'/'Ends on'), tables-section, toggle-qr-btn, print-qr-btn, tables-qr-grid, .table-qr-card, download-qr-N. Razorpay env is intentionally empty — /api/payments/config.configured=false and fallback_link='https://razorpay.me/@prem9300'. To re-test from a 'fresh' state, set autopay_enabled=false via PUT /api/subscription/autopay {enabled:false} before reloading Subscribe page (otherwise the chip will show 'ON' due to prior test runs). Customer PIN drift caveat: if you see 401 'Incorrect PIN' on /api/auth/customer-login with 1234, PUT /api/settings/customer-pin {new_pin:'1234'} first.
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. One minor environmental drift detected and corrected (customer PIN was 1111, restored to 1234). All iter9 backend endpoints behave per spec; all frontend testids render correctly with proper data and styling.
